versions.content: The function Fr_GetPOCStatus shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Query the CC’s actual POC status by reading the CHI variable ‘vPOC’ and write the result to parameter Fr_POCStatusPtr. 2. Return E_OK.
